title: IOE Lớp 4 - Chuyên đề 2 - Vòng Quốc Gia

part_A.question: There are ... high buildings in Thailand.
part_A.explanation: "many + danh từ đếm được số nhiều" = nhiều (high buildings).

part_A.question: Can I ... your name, please? - I’m Simon Cowell.
part_A.explanation: "Can I have your name?" = Cho tôi biết tên bạn được không? Sau "Can I" dùng nguyên thể.

part_A.question: ___ your mother’s birthday on the eleventh of December?
part_A.explanation: Câu hỏi với "be": Is + sở hữu cách + birthday + on + ngày?

part_A.question: Let’s … a birthday party for dad this weekend.
part_A.explanation: "have a party" = tổ chức tiệc; sau "Let's" dùng nguyên thể.

part_A.question: Andy is scared of water. He cannot … at all.
part_A.explanation: "not … at all" = không hề; sau "cannot" dùng nguyên thể "swim".

part_A.question: What is your ... food? – I like hamburger the most.
part_A.explanation: "favourite food" = món ăn yêu thích; trả lời "I like hamburger the most."

part_A.question: I don’t like cooking but I ... singing.
part_A.explanation: "but" nối hai vế đối lập: don't like cooking but like singing.

part_A.question: Hi, Mai. ___ my house. Come in, please.
part_A.explanation: "Welcome to + nơi chốn" = Chào mừng đến…

part_A.question: Would you like ... to the movies tonight?
part_A.explanation: "Would you like to + V nguyên thể?" = lời mời lịch sự.

part_A.question: Mr. Minh ... in town. His house is in the countryside.
part_A.explanation: Câu phủ định hiện tại đơn với chủ ngữ số ít: doesn't live.

part_A.question: A: … were you last night? - B: I was at the cinema with my friend.
part_A.explanation: "Where were you last night?" – "last night" là quá khứ nên dùng "were".

part_A.question: I ... Monday and Wednesday because I have Maths lessons then.
part_A.explanation: "like + danh từ" = thích cái gì; "because" nêu lý do thích hai ngày đó.

part_A.question: Your sister looks so … . – Yes, she plays tennis very often.
part_A.explanation: "sporty" = thích/giỏi thể thao, phù hợp với vế "she plays tennis very often".

part_A.question: My new friends ... Kate and Mary. They are from Singapore.
part_A.explanation: Chủ ngữ số nhiều "My new friends" nên dùng "are".

part_A.question: The weather is ______ today. Let’s go for a picnic.
part_A.explanation: "The weather is fine." = Trời đẹp, nên rủ đi dã ngoại.

part_A.question: Where is Paul? – He’s … puzzles in the living room.
part_A.explanation: Hiện tại tiếp diễn: He's doing puzzles (đang chơi xếp hình).

part_A.question: ___ do you have Science? – I have it on Mondays.
part_A.explanation: "When" hỏi thời gian; trả lời "on Mondays".

part_A.question: ___ is your school, Mai? – My school is in Nguyen Trai Street.
part_A.explanation: "Where" hỏi vị trí; trả lời tên đường.

part_A.question: What’s your favourite _______? – It’s Aladin and the Magic Lamp.
part_A.explanation: "story" = câu chuyện; "Aladin and the Magic Lamp" là một câu chuyện.

part_A.question: These are my new classmates, Mary and Susan. They … from Australia.
part_A.explanation: "come from + nơi chốn"; chủ ngữ số nhiều nên không thêm -s.

part_A.question: … subject do you prefer, English or Music?
part_A.explanation: "Which" dùng khi có lựa chọn giới hạn: English or Music.

part_A.question: Why do you want to go shopping? – Because ... .
part_A.explanation: "Because + mệnh đề" nêu lý do: vì tôi thấy chán.

part_A.question: A: What does your father …? - B: Playing tennis and chess.
part_A.explanation: Sau "like" dùng V-ing: Playing tennis and chess.

part_A.question: I learn ... read and write during English lessons.
part_A.explanation: "learn to + V nguyên thể" = học làm gì.

part_A.question: A: … is your birthday, Jack? - B: It’s on thirteenth of May.
part_A.explanation: "When" hỏi thời gian sinh nhật; trả lời ngày tháng.

part_A.question: I love … because I can do outdoor activities.
part_A.explanation: "because" nêu lý do yêu thích môn PE.

part_A.question: Mr. Baker … breakfast at the moment.
part_A.explanation: "at the moment" là dấu hiệu hiện tại tiếp diễn: is having breakfast.

part_A.question: I ___ at Chu Van An Primary School. Nice to meet you, Linh. – Nice to meet you, too.
part_A.explanation: "study at + tên trường" = học ở trường nào.

part_A.question: … August, children come back to school after summer holiday.
part_A.explanation: Trước tháng dùng "In": In August…

part_A.question: Yesterday, he didn’t go to the library. He … to the zoo.
part_A.explanation: "Yesterday" là quá khứ; dạng quá khứ của "go" là "went".

part_A.question: ___ is your birthday, Mai? – It’s on the twenty-sixth of March.
part_A.explanation: "When" hỏi thời gian; trả lời "on the twenty-sixth of March".

part_A.question: Before I go to bed at 10 p.m., my mother says to me: ’’…, son.’’
part_A.explanation: "Good night" = Chúc ngủ ngon (dùng trước khi đi ngủ).

part_A.question: My parents ... Ha Long Bay last summer.
part_A.explanation: "last summer" là quá khứ nên động từ thêm -ed: visited.

part_A.question: Jane ... shopping on Saturday. She’ll visit her grandma.
part_A.explanation: Phủ định tương lai: won't go = sẽ không đi.

part_A.question: Mary: Where were you yesterday, Jane? - Jane: Lucy and I … at the art museum.
part_A.explanation: Chủ ngữ số nhiều "Lucy and I" ở quá khứ dùng "were".

part_A.question: Where do you live? – I live …107 Tran Dang Ninh Street with my parents.
part_A.explanation: Trước số nhà cụ thể dùng "at": at 107 Tran Dang Ninh Street.

part_A.question: My brother’s hobby is … photos of trees and flowers.
part_A.explanation: "hobby is + V-ing": taking photos = chụp ảnh.

part_A.question: Is Mrs. Barbara going to buy some apples ... her children?
part_A.explanation: "buy something for somebody" = mua gì cho ai.

part_A.question: ___ is your mother’s birthday, Phuong? – It’s on the tenth of November.
part_A.explanation: "When" hỏi thời gian; trả lời "on the tenth of November".

part_A.question: What time does the school library … ? – It closes at 5:30 p.m.
part_A.explanation: Sau trợ động từ "does" dùng động từ nguyên thể "close".

part_A.question: The children … learning Science in the classroom.
part_A.explanation: Hiện tại tiếp diễn số nhiều: The children are learning…

part_A.question: Nam hates PE lessons. He doesn’t like _______ sports at all.
part_A.explanation: Sau "like" dùng V-ing: playing sports; "not … at all" = không hề.

part_A.question: ... do you usually finish work in the afternoon? – At 5.30 p.m.
part_A.explanation: "What time…?" hỏi giờ; trả lời "At 5.30 p.m."

part_A.question: I love … lessons because I can learn how to use the computer.
part_A.explanation: "IT lessons" = tiết Tin học, nơi học dùng máy tính.

part_A.question: Next Sunday, I ... go to the church but I will visit my grandmother.
part_A.explanation: Phủ định tương lai "won't" đối lập với "will" ở vế sau.

part_A.question: Look ___ the timetable, please. We have English on Thursdays.
part_A.explanation: "look at" = nhìn vào (động từ đi với "at").

part_A.question: ______ was the fireworks display? – It was colourful and beautiful.
part_A.explanation: "How was…?" hỏi cảm nhận về sự việc đã qua; trả lời bằng tính từ.

part_A.question: … spring, my father and I often go fishing at the pond behind my house.
part_A.explanation: Trước mùa dùng "In": In spring…

part_A.question: Yesterday was such a long day to my dad. He … in the factory from early morning until midnight.
part_A.explanation: "Yesterday" là quá khứ nên động từ thêm -ed: worked.

part_A.question: Dad is reading a book in the library and Mom is … dishes in the kitchen.
part_A.explanation: Hai vế hiện tại tiếp diễn nối bằng "and": is reading … is washing.

part_A.question: Why do you like Music lessons? – _ _ _ _ _ _ _ I like singing very much.
part_A.explanation: "Because" mở đầu câu trả lời cho câu hỏi "Why".

part_A.question: I’m not hungry _ _ _ I’m thirsty.
part_A.explanation: "but" nối hai vế đối lập: not hungry but thirsty.

part_A.question: Would you like to come _ _ _ dinner tonight?
part_A.explanation: "come for dinner" = đến ăn tối.

part_A.question: Last weekend, we played volleyball _ _ the beach.
part_A.explanation: "on the beach" = trên bãi biển.

part_A.question: Tam comes _ _ _ _ a small village in Quang Nam.
part_A.explanation: "come from + nơi chốn" = đến từ đâu.

part_A.question: Mary is cutting the cake _ _ _ _ a sharp knife.
part_A.explanation: "cut something with + dụng cụ" = cắt bằng…

part_A.question: My little sister likes p_ _ _ ing with her toys and teddy bear.
part_A.explanation: Sau "likes" dùng V-ing: playing with her toys.

part_A.question: Hello, I’m Alan. How are you? - I’m fine, thanks. _ _ _ you?
part_A.explanation: "And you?" = Còn bạn thì sao?

part_A.question: What will we have _ _ _ dinner? - Rice and noodles.
part_A.explanation: "for dinner" = cho bữa tối.

part_A.question: Science lessons _ _ _ very interesting.
part_A.explanation: Chủ ngữ số nhiều "Science lessons" nên dùng "are".

part_A.question: Last night, Ruby spoke to her mother _ _ _ _ _ her hobby.
part_A.explanation: "speak to somebody about something" = nói với ai về điều gì (quá khứ: spoke).

part_A.question: You look tired, Hoa. _ _ _ _ _ you like some orange juice?
part_A.explanation: "Would you like some…?" = lời mời lịch sự.

part_A.question: All of my friends like watching cartoons _ _ TV.
part_A.explanation: "on TV" = trên ti vi (cụm cố định).

part_A.question: My mother is tired because she has to _ _ the housework all day.
part_A.explanation: "do the housework" = làm việc nhà; "has to" = phải.

part_A.question: Will you go on holiday _ _ _ _ your family next year?
part_A.explanation: "go on holiday with somebody" = đi nghỉ cùng ai.

part_A.question: My uncle works in the factory _ _ _ _ Monday to Friday.
part_A.explanation: Cấu trúc "from Monday to Friday" = từ thứ Hai đến thứ Sáu.

part_A.question: What are you d_ _ _ _ now? – I am reading books.
part_A.explanation: "now" là dấu hiệu hiện tại tiếp diễn: What are you doing now?

part_A.question: Do you have _ _ _ sisters? - Yes, I have two sisters.
part_A.explanation: Trong câu hỏi dùng "any": Do you have any sisters?

part_A.question: Let’s buy a big present _ _ _ her birthday party.
part_A.explanation: "buy something for + dịp" = mua gì cho dịp nào.

part_A.question: You should brush your teeth _ _ _ _ _ meals.
part_A.explanation: "after meals" = sau bữa ăn; "should + V nguyên thể" = nên làm gì.

part_A.question: Their children are listening _ _ “The Wheels on the Bus”.
part_A.explanation: "listen to + bài hát" = nghe bài hát nào.

part_A.question: My little son’s classroom is _ _ the second floor.
part_A.explanation: "on the second floor" = ở tầng hai.

part_A.question: How _ _ _ _ notebooks are there in your bag? – There are 5.
part_A.explanation: "How many + danh từ số nhiều" để hỏi số lượng.

part_A.question: Nam: When is your birthday? Lan: _ _ _ _ Monday. On May 6th .
part_A.explanation: "Next Monday" = thứ Hai tuần sau (thời gian tương lai).

part_A.question: How many fingers _ _ _ _ a person have?
part_A.explanation: Câu hỏi hiện tại đơn với chủ ngữ số ít "a person" dùng "does".

part_A.question: We sh_ _ _ _ do morning exercise regularly.
part_A.explanation: "should + V nguyên thể" = nên làm gì.

part_A.question: November comes _ _ _ _ _ _ December.
part_A.explanation: "come before" = đến trước; tháng Mười Một trước tháng Mười Hai.

part_A.question: Tam washes his face and _ _ _ breakfast at 7 o’clock.
part_A.explanation: Chủ ngữ số ít nên động từ thêm -s/-es: washes… has…

part_A.question: I like seafood and fruit. What _ _ _ _ _ you?
part_A.explanation: "What about you?" = Còn bạn thì sao?

part_A.question: Please raise your hands _ _ to answer the teacher’s question!
part_A.explanation: "raise your hands up" = giơ tay lên (câu mệnh lệnh).

part_A.question: How _ _ _ _ bananas are there in the fridge?
part_A.explanation: "How many + danh từ số nhiều (bananas)" để hỏi số lượng.

part_A.question: The Smiths _ _ _ _ at home all day yesterday.
part_A.explanation: "The Smiths" (gia đình Smith) là số nhiều; quá khứ dùng "were".

part_A.question: I’d _ _ _ e a banana and a glass of water, please.
part_A.explanation: "I'd like…" = Tôi muốn… (cách nói lịch sự).

part_A.question: Wait a minute. I’d like to buy some chocolate _ _ _ Sue.
part_A.explanation: "buy something for somebody" = mua gì cho ai.

part_A.question: My little sister likes playing _ _ _ _ a yo-yo.
part_A.explanation: "play with + đồ chơi" = chơi với…

part_A.question: My friends and I _ _ _ making some paper planes.
part_A.explanation: Hiện tại tiếp diễn với chủ ngữ số nhiều: are making.

part_A.question: An: Where are you from? Peter: England. What _ _ _ _ _ you?
part_A.explanation: "What about you?" = Còn bạn thì sao?

part_A.question: Mai and Phong _ _ _ _ in the school library yesterday afternoon.
part_A.explanation: "yesterday afternoon" là quá khứ; chủ ngữ số nhiều dùng "were".

part_A.question: I’m going to stay _ _ _ _ my grandparents this summer.
part_A.explanation: Tương lai gần: be going to + V; "stay with somebody" = ở cùng ai.

part_A.question: Jane: Happy birthday, Mary. This gift is for you. – Mary: Thank you _ _ _ _ much.
part_A.explanation: "Thank you very much." = Cảm ơn rất nhiều.

part_A.question: The past form of “PLAY” is _ _ _ _ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: Dạng quá khứ của "play" là "played" (động từ có quy tắc).

part_A.question: Every day, I _ _ _ up early to do morning exercises.
part_A.explanation: "get up early" = dậy sớm; "to + V" chỉ mục đích.

part_A.question: Mai likes flowers because _ _ _ _ are beautiful.
part_A.explanation: "because" nêu lý do; "they" thay cho "flowers".

part_A.question: Lan: Where _ _ _ _ you yesterday? - Hoa: I was at my grandparents.
part_A.explanation: "Where were you yesterday?" – quá khứ với "be".

part_A.question: Remember to drink water every day. It’s good _ _ _ our health.
part_A.explanation: "be good for + danh từ" = tốt cho…

part_A.question: Nam p_ _ _ s the guitar with his friends on Fridays.
part_A.explanation: "play the guitar" – nhạc cụ đi với "the".

part_A.question: He _ _ _ _ _ football with his friends every afternoon.
part_A.explanation: Chủ ngữ số ít "He" nên động từ thêm -s: plays.

part_A.question: Phuong likes playing the piano _ _ _ _ her sisters.
part_A.explanation: "play the piano with somebody" = chơi đàn cùng ai.

part_A.question: How _ _ _ _ windows are there in your classroom? - There is only one.
part_A.explanation: "How many windows…?" – trả lời "There is only one."

part_A.question: Hung: _ _ _ do you drink milk every day? Nga: Because it’s good for my health.
part_A.explanation: "Why" hỏi lý do; trả lời bắt đầu bằng "Because".

part_A.question: Look! The boys are talking _ _ _ _ _ the football match.
part_A.explanation: "Look!" là dấu hiệu hiện tại tiếp diễn; "talk about" = nói về.

part_A.question: How _ _ _ _ sweets are there in a packet? – Twenty.
part_A.explanation: "How many sweets…?" = Có bao nhiêu cái kẹo…?

part_A.question: She got a letter _ _ _ _ her penfriend in Malaysia.
part_A.explanation: "a letter from + người" = thư của ai gửi.

part_A.question: Linh: _ _ _ _ do you have Science classes? - Hoa: On Tuesday morning and Friday afternoon.
part_A.explanation: "When" hỏi thời gian; trả lời các buổi học cụ thể.

part_A.question: I’m so thirsty! I’d _ _ _ _ a lemonade, please.
part_A.explanation: "thirsty" = khát; "I'd like a lemonade" = tôi muốn một cốc nước chanh.

part_A.question: Jack is playing soccer _ _ _ _ his friends in the school yard.
part_A.explanation: "play soccer with somebody" = chơi bóng đá với ai.

part_A.question: How _ _ _ _ pupils are there in her classroom? – There are 40 pupils.
part_A.explanation: "How many pupils…?" – trả lời "There are 40 pupils."

part_A.question: They _ _ _ _ _ _ table tennis yesterday.
part_A.explanation: "yesterday" là quá khứ nên động từ thêm -ed: played.

part_A.question: Children shouldn’t drink coffee. It is not good _ _ _ their health.
part_A.explanation: "shouldn't + V nguyên thể" = không nên; "good for" = tốt cho.

part_A.question: On Saturday afternoons, John _ _ _ _ _ tennis or goes swimming.
part_A.explanation: "or" nối hai hoạt động; chủ ngữ số ít nên động từ thêm -s.

part_A.question: Be_ _ _ _ coming home, I go to the market and buy some vegetables.
part_A.explanation: "Before + V-ing" = trước khi làm gì.

part_A.question: What are you doing now? - I’m _ _ _ _ _ _ _ football.
part_A.explanation: "now" là dấu hiệu hiện tại tiếp diễn: I'm playing football.

part_A.question: The children are playing with _ _ _ _ _ friends at the school yard.
part_A.explanation: "their friends" – nói về "the children" (số nhiều) nên dùng "their".

part_A.question: They are _ _ _ _ _ _ _ football in the school yard.
part_A.explanation: Hiện tại tiếp diễn số nhiều: They are playing football.

part_A.question: What is Danny _ _ _ _ _ ? - He is watching television in the living-room.
part_A.explanation: Hiện tại tiếp diễn: What is Danny doing? – He is watching television.

part_A.question: Our grandparents are both old now _ _ _ still very strong because they go jogging every day.
part_A.explanation: "but" nối hai vế đối lập: già nhưng vẫn khỏe.

part_A.question: After dinner, my mother checks my homework b_ _ _ _ _ bedtime.
part_A.explanation: "before bedtime" = trước giờ đi ngủ.

part_A.question: I like English _ _ _ _ _ _ _ it’s very interesting.
part_A.explanation: "because" nêu lý do thích tiếng Anh.

part_A.question: He’s always busy _ _ _ _ _ _ _ he’s a businessman.
part_A.explanation: "because" nêu lý do luôn bận: vì là doanh nhân.

part_A.question: Vinh: _ _ _ _ _ are you going on vacation next summer? Anh: I’m going to travel to London.
part_A.explanation: "Where" hỏi nơi chốn; trả lời "I'm going to travel to London."

part_A.question: woman. / My teacher is / and intelligent / a hard-working /
part_A.answer: My teacher is a hard-working and intelligent woman.
part_A.explanation: S + be + a + hai tính từ nối bằng "and" + danh từ.

part_A.question: my / sister's / birthday. / I don't / remember /
part_A.answer: I don't remember my sister's birthday.
part_A.explanation: Câu phủ định hiện tại đơn: I don't remember + tân ngữ.

part_A.question: eighth of / the / July. / on / My birthday is /
part_A.answer: My birthday is on the eighth of July.
part_A.explanation: Ngày tháng: on the eighth of July.

part_A.question: lunch in / room. / the dining / I am / having /
part_A.answer: I am having lunch in the dining room.
part_A.explanation: Hiện tại tiếp diễn: I am having lunch + nơi chốn.

part_A.question: sisters / you have? / How many / brothers and / do /
part_A.answer: How many brothers and sisters do you have?
part_A.explanation: Câu hỏi số lượng: How many + A and B + do you have?

part_A.question: one / younger sisters. / and two / brother / He has /
part_A.answer: He has one brother and two younger sisters.
part_A.explanation: S + has + số lượng + danh từ (số ít/số nhiều tương ứng).

part_A.question: There are / garden. / in / many roses / the flower /
part_A.answer: There are many roses in the flower garden.
part_A.explanation: "There are many + danh từ số nhiều + nơi chốn."

part_A.question: to dinner / coming / my family? / with / What about /
part_A.answer: What about coming to dinner with my family?
part_A.explanation: "What about + V-ing?" = Còn việc… thì sao?

part_A.question: by minibus? / going to / about / How / Huong Pagoda /
part_A.answer: How about going to Huong Pagoda by minibus?
part_A.explanation: "How about + V-ing … by + phương tiện?" = Hay là… bằng…?

part_A.question: How much / potatoes and / some beef. / I’d like some / are they? /
part_A.answer: I’d like some potatoes and some beef. How much are they?
part_A.explanation: "I'd like some…" + câu hỏi giá "How much are they?"

part_A.question: Does he / presents / on / get any / his birthday? /
part_A.answer: Does he get any presents on his birthday?
part_A.explanation: Câu hỏi với "Does" + any + danh từ số nhiều.

part_A.question: the only / Melanie is / Mrs. Daisy. / daughter / of /
part_A.answer: Melanie is the only daughter of Mrs. Daisy.
part_A.explanation: "the only daughter of + người" = con gái duy nhất của…

part_A.question: club. / speaking / an English / I am / going to /
part_A.answer: I am going to an English speaking club.
part_A.explanation: Tương lai gần: am going to + nơi chốn (câu lược bớt động từ).

part_A.question: are there / many / circles / How / in the poster? /
part_A.answer: How many circles are there in the poster?
